en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a group of uniformed men posing around a large horse‑drawn wagon on a muddy street in front of a walled garden and stone house. The men wear light-colored military or paramilitary uniforms with kepi-style caps, tall boots, and bandoliers or rolled equipment slung over their shoulders. Some stand on the ground with poles or rifles, others sit or stand on the wagon; a driver sits at the front holding the reins of two horses. The background shows bare winter trees and an iron fence. In the upper-right corner there are remnants of green postal cancellation and stamp marks, suggesting the image side of a mailed postcard. There is no clearly legible caption or printed title visible.
